title: FB-003 repair local worker claim lifecycle
summary: Completed FB-003 by stopping spawned local-worker children when post-spawn claim updates fail and by releasing dead prior-run result claims to a non-active stale-result status so the source can be claimed again.
reason: Worker findings FR-007 and FR-009 showed local-worker duplicate-safety could fail in two ways: orphaning a spawned child after claim-update failure, and permanently blocking a source behind a stale result_ready claim.
behavior_before: A local worker child that spawned successfully could continue processing if the parent failed to update the claim to running, and repair preserved dead-worker result files as active result_ready claims with no current-run consumer.
behavior_after: The parent stops a spawned child before releasing the claim on post-spawn update failure, and repair releases dead result-bearing claims as released_stale_result with diagnostic notes so future claims are not blocked.
tests_added: ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-LocalWorkerClaimLifecycleChecks.ps1 covers stale result_ready repair and post-spawn claim-update failure cleanup.
ops/pipeline/tests/Invoke-ReliabilityRegressionChecks.ps1 now includes the local worker claim lifecycle unit check.
manual_validation: Strict change-control coverage was run with --require-worktree-coverage. FB-003 files are covered; validation still fails because unrelated dirty files are uncovered: docs/implementation/encoder-breadth-av1-plan.md and docs/reviews/function-module-audit-2026-06-11/workers/worker-08-webview-pages.md.
rollback_plan: Revert the local worker claim repair and post-spawn cleanup changes, remove the local worker lifecycle unit script and reliability wrapper entry, restore the prior queue engine static assertion, and rerun the queue/reliability checks.
notes: Automatic finalization of prior-run worker result files was not added; stale result files remain available for diagnostics while the claim is released for retry.
